motor_channels: logical motor indices 0..3; same indices as cached DShot telemetry; mapping requires response consistency check

fields.fdErpm[0..3]: 100 electrical RPM per LSB; mechanical RPM = value*200/motor_poles
fields.fdErpmAge[0..3]: 100 microseconds since last valid telemetry decode; 65535 unknown or saturated; decode time is not ESC capture time
fields.fdTelemetryMask: bits0..3: telemetry has been seen and last decode age <=10ms
fields.fdPidSum[0..2]: actual final rate PID Sum, 0.01 PID units per LSB
fields.fdCorrection[0..2]: actual additional correction, 0.001 PID units per LSB
fields.fdCandidate[0..2]: unblended absolute candidate, 0.1 PID units per LSB, saturated at signed16 range
fields.fdAttitude[0..3]: 0.01 degrees; propagated UKF roll,pitch then BF roll,pitch; UKF -32768 if invalid
fields.fdUkfAge: microseconds since last completed UKF correction, 65535 invalid/saturated; gyro propagation continues between corrections
fields.fdUkfAccelRejected: bit0 last completed update rejected accel; bit1 dynamic accel/high-rate 150ms hold active

preserved: debug UKF applied difference/peak timing/rejection reason
analysis: Raw fields are additional independent fields in each I/P frame. New logs do not depend on changing the debug mode. No automatic tuning or parameter application.
user_observation: User reports moving one axis at a time in prior flights; failed identification must not be attributed to simultaneous stick inputs without evidence.
